title: Latency-Weighted Opportunity Curve (LWOC) prioritization framework
creator: Aisha Gupta
description: Problem: Existing RICE variants on the roadmap often miss the operational impact of latency-sensitive features and the non-linear relationship between quality-of-service and business value. This ticket proposes a new prioritization heuristic: the Latency-Weighted Opportunity Curve (LWOC), which augments RICE by combining an S-shaped opportunity scaling term with per-feature latency sensitivity and unit-cost adjustments. The goal is a repeatable rubric product managers and platform leads can use to rank initiatives that span runtime, console, and Dedicated/Private deployment investments.
background: We regularly see features with moderate reach but high latency sensitivity (e.g., streaming API improvements, prefix caching) have outsized downstream revenue and churn effects when latency crosses thresholds. Traditional RICE treats reach and impact linearly. LWOC encodes: (1) non-linear impact growth near latency thresholds via an S-curve, (2) cost-per-token or per-request penalty, and (3) confidence adjustments from evals. This helps prioritize modest-scope engineering work that preserves SLAs and customer experience.
scoring_method: LWOC score = (Reach * OpportunityScale(LatencySensitivity, ExpectedLatencyDelta) * Impact) * Confidence / (CostAdjusted + OperationalRiskFactor). OpportunityScale uses a logistic S-curve: S(x) = 1 / (1 + exp(-k*(x - x0))) where x is expected end-user latency improvement (ms) normalized relative to the customer-defined sensitivity threshold. CostAdjusted = base_cost * (1 + quantizationFactor) where quantizationFactor accounts for implementation complexity (0.0 - 1.0). Confidence is mapped from qualitative evals to 0.2-1.0. OperationalRiskFactor adds damping for rollout complexity and rollback risk.
sample_scores: Example A - Streaming token batching: Reach=120k DAU-equivalent, ExpectedLatencyDelta=30ms, LatencySensitivityThreshold=25ms, k=0.25, x0=0 => OpportunityScale=0.56, Impact=8 => numerator=120000*0.56*8=537600; Confidence=0.9 => 483840; base_cost=$18k => CostAdjusted=$22k (quantizationFactor=0.22); OperationalRiskFactor=1.1 => LWOC≈483840/(22000*1.1)=19.97 => High priority

Example B - Console UX chart polish: Reach=8k, ExpectedLatencyDelta=0ms, OpportunityScale≈0.05, Impact=3 => numerator small; base_cost=$3k => LWOC<<1 => Low priority compared to latency-sensitive infra work
acceptance_criteria: Define default parameter values and mapping tables for OpportunityScale (k, x0) per workload class (API-serving, console, batch).
